## High-terrain shelf check

1,115 sampled points inside Class B/C shelves with MSL floors were checked against Open-Meteo ground elevation (DEN, SLC, LAS, PHX, ABQ, COS, RNO, TUS, BOI, ELP). **No point was below 400 ft AGL.** The closest were BOI 591, DEN 597 and ABQ 631 ft AGL. The app's raw-MSL "< 500" filter is safe today because of this margin, not because its logic is correct. The sampling is coarse (6×6 per polygon bounding box).
